I implemented the intermediate-layer prediction and switchable dropout feature by porting the exact upstream DeepChem changes (commit `87bdca6a7`, "New mechanism for enabling dropout during uncertainty prediction") to the source files. - `_predict` now takes an `outputs` argument. - Added `SwitchedDropout(tf.keras.layers.Layer)`: takes `rate` in the constructor and `call([tensor, switch])` applies `tf.nn.dropout` at `rate * switch`, so switch `1.0` enables dropout and `0.0` passes input through unchanged.
